## News fragment

User-visible changes should add a Towncrier fragment under `newsfragments/<issue>.<type>.rst` unless the PR carries the `no-news-required` label.

Valid fragment types:

- `feature`
- `bugfix`
- `doc`
- `removals`
- `misc`
